notes.title: Update notes for 3 Sep 2024
notes.content: Some users are facing disconnection issues when playing multiplayer game. We have made a change to fix this issue

notes.title: Update for 4 Dec 2023
notes.content: Fixed a small bug after the most recent enhancements.

notes.title: Update notes for 29 Nov 2023
notes.content: streamlined two of the puzzles so that the interaction is smoother.

notes.title: Update notes for 5 Jun
notes.content:
the main purpose is to make the game slightly easier without making big changes to the puzzles or flow. This is a quick summary of the changes:
added a barrier for the first puzzle, so players have to solve the box before they burn the cobwebs to enter the giant cave
placed one of the blocks directly in the totem as a clue
made the symbols on the stone statue light up as a clue
